phaseMeaning.H: Coherent historical runtime, original sum of individual power, original 32-step search and trial RNG consumption
phaseMeaning.C9: Actual current production implementation 15.2, V5 gear and V3 skills both sides, tempo 1.75 and slinger range 1..3, same common-projection fixtures as pilot

scenarioMeaning: Unchanged common-projection MID+3 T3 versus the identical T3 with one ordinary MID+3 BRUISER; no GUARD, staff+orb instead of battle_staff
seedDerivation: First six bytes of SHA256(namespace+'/'+groupId+'/'+pair), big-endian positive long; groupId=251, pair=0..499; same roots for both conditions and phases, not a claim of identical engine event streams
score: Mean of two mirrored outcomes: WIN=1, DRAW=0.5, LOSS=0; TIMEOUT is not LOSS and makes the whole associated comparison pair incomplete

confidence.method: Simultaneous two-sided Hoeffding by complete independent pair index, Bonferroni family of three; means in probability units
confidence.scope: Fixed compositions and level only; not universal win probabilities, monotonicity guarantee or a 50/50 target

stopping: Exactly this single confirmation, no interim selection, formula/parameter changes, extra levels, extra phases or sample extension after outcomes; report uncertainty if inconclusive
authorizationScope: Outside-production diagnostic helpers and evidence only; no game source, target rebuild, database, bot, release activation, enhancement outcome curve, commit or push
